All prior audit findings are resolved: (1) TestRFC8893RedistributePolicyFiltersByRPKIValidationState now compiles the identical rpki-validation-state match filter against "redistribute import" via policy.CompileRouteChain and executes real configredist.NewEvaluator + handleBatch + BGP consumer for both BGP per-entry OriginAS and non-BGP static routes (which now fall back to BGP's published ribpolicy.LocalOriginAS() via applyBatchOriginAS, published by reactor.New and reload_globals.go::setGlobals), asserting exact injected prefixes; (2) TestRFC8893RedistributeInactiveValidatorRefusesValidMatch proves inactive-validator rejection through handleBatch; (3) TestRFC8893SamePolicyPrimitiveAcrossIngressRedistributionAndEgress and TestRFC8893ValidationStatePrimitiveRefusesInvalidConfigAndInactiveValidator compile against real "bgp import" and "bgp export" attachments (no test-only attachments) and verify unknown/empty state refusal and inactive-validator refusal across all three policy points (BGP ingress, route/redistribution, BGP egress). Ze's unified policy configuration primitive (policy match rpki-validation-state [ valid | not-found | invalid ]) is identical across ingress, redistribution, and egress (bgp rpki action is the separate RFC 6811 Section 3 Adj-RIB-In eligibility gate outside the policy engine).
